description: Use this when asked 'What circuit does my home EV charger need and might my panel need an upgrade?' or 'What have utilities seen home Level 2 charger installs cost, and can I still get the federal credit?' Returns safety first, the exact 125% minimum breaker calculation, panel triage, unpriced extras and dated federal 30C rules. Reference cards are utility and DOE program figures, not a price for this home. A licensed electrician and permit are needed; confirm local requirements and inspection. Pure rules and Decimal, no network, model or clock. Web and MCP share the free daily allowance. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

capacity_check.description: Electrician load calculation result; not_done means not assessed.

charger_amps.description: Rated or installer-set maximum charging current in amps.

existing_circuit.description: Suitable dedicated circuit already at the parking spot.

installed_on.description: Placed-in-service date YYYY-MM-DD; omitted follows the after-2026-06-30 rule.

panel_amps.description: Panel/service rating, echoed only; a panel label alone cannot decide an upgrade or price the job.

run_feet.description: Estimated routed panel-to-charger length, not straight-line distance.

spare_space.description: Compatible breaker space for a new circuit.
